name: resource-hero
description: Listing hero of the Resource Center, its type listings (Blog, Case Studies, Success Stories, White Papers, Webinars) and the Press Room, after live's ap-r26 hero: eyebrow, H1, one line of copy, the instant search field (resource-search), and a rail of category tabs (All + the first few, a ••• button opens the rest) over a soft gradient wash.

search.description: resource-search props; the field is left out when empty or without index_url.

tabs.description: Category tabs in order. Each: label (required), url (required), active (boolean).

tabs_label.description: Accessible name of the tab rail.

visible_tabs.description: Tabs shown before the ••• button on wide screens (All counts as one). Phones scroll the whole rail instead.
